fact: The Director-General of the Registries, Notary and Identification services said the services have a fully computerised system including a civil registry information system, and that birth and death certificates are now signed electronically.
title: Assinatura Electrónica já é uma realidade nos serviços dos Registos, Notariado e Identificação
publisher: Expresso das Ilhas, via Caixa Económica de Cabo Verde
